title: itshover: an open-source icon library where motion comes first  #github
description:
Static icons feel dead — and itshover is the fix. itshover is an open-source icon library where motion comes first, not as decoration, but as part of the design. Every icon is a fully editable React component with animation baked right in. You don’t install a heavy library or lock yourself in. You just copy, paste, and customize the SVG motion directly in your code.
#github #opensource
